title: Balanced Leek and Broccoli Soup
subtitle: with Vegan Cheddar and Croutons
description: Our 'balanced' recipes are just that – high in nutritive value (that's fibre-rich veggies, lean proteins and wholegrains, just between us), so these dishes are good for you in every which way! They're perfect for anyone looking to minimise their intake of refined foods without sacrificing on taste.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Cut the broccoli stem into 1cm chunks. Cut the head into small florets. Thinly slice the leek. Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Crumble the stock cubes into a heatproof jug, add 500ml (2 cups) boiling water and stir to dissolve.

Start soup: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Cook the leek, stirring, for 5 mins or until softened. Add the broccoli and cook, stirring, for 3 mins. Add the country seasoning and cook, stirring, for a further 1 min or until the broccoli is almost tender.

Finish soup: Add the chickpeas, stock and 60ml (¼ cup) plant-based milk to the veggies and bring to the boil. Cover and cook over medium-low heat for 5 mins or until the broccoli is tender. Remove the pan from the heat.
Grill croutons: Meanwhile, preheat the grill to high. Tear the rolls into large chunks. Put on an oven tray and grill for 4-5 mins until golden.

Serve up: Blend the soup with a stick blender or food processor until smooth (see Kitchen hack). Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the broccoli soup among bowls and top with the vegan cheddar and croutons. Enjoy!
Kitchen hack: If you don't have a stick blender or food processor, simply mash the broccoli mixture with a potato masher. The result won't be as smooth but it will be just as delicious!
